$comment: P8-03: conversation summaries, live (gpt-6-luna, summary-v1). All 114 indexed episodes summarised with `pnpm ingest summarise --budget 0.70` (~$0.419 against an estimate of ~$0.556); every stored moment, question and answer re-checked in code against its passage; ten episodes, spread across the knowledge base, judged against their full transcripts (eval/summaries.ts). The first judge run counted adverts anywhere in the transcript; the judge now names the advert moments by label, and only real labels count. This file is that second run. Scores and notes only, no transcript text.
